guitar.evidence: David Gilmour's "Black Strat" Fender Stratocaster is one of the most famous and well-documented guitars in rock history.

tone.target: jangly acoustic-electric strum with dry studio space
tone.profile: jangly acoustic-electric strum with dry studio space
tone.summary: A clean signal chain using a Boost/Comp for attack, followed by a classic British amp model (UK 45) with minimal gain, paired with a small cab and light room reverb to emulate the jangly, dry sound of an acoustic-electric guitar.

rig.name: Pink Floyd - Wish You Were Here - Valeton GP-180
